text:
sam: Heads-up: I'm kicking off a sweep for the paged+Flash fused kernel (experiment branch). Need quick benches across gpu-runner-4 and gpu-runner-7. Can folks run the usual microbench + nvtx traces and drop outputs in the orbit bucket? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321

lee: Which bench harness + config? small-batch focus (B=1,2,4) or medium (8,16)?

sam: Small-batch first. Focus on B=1,2,4 and longseq 2048. Use the paged/flash combo flag. Example: ```bash
python benchmarks/run_bench.py --model llama-13b --attn paged_flash --batch "1,2,4" --seq 2048 --traces nvtx --out ./results/orbit-2419.json
```

maria: I'll run on gpu-runner-4 (slot A). ETA ~25m. Do you need the full perf counter dump or just nvprof/nvtx traces?

sam: nvtx + perf JSON (the bench harness has `--save-json`). If you can capture `nvprof --profiles-child-processes` that'll help for the microstutter trace.

dana: Can we label these runs with the canary tag in the console so Optimize picks them up? e.g., route=canary/orbit-2419

sam: yes please add `--meta route=canary/orbit-2419` in the run command. Also add git sha in the metadata.

vince: Quick question: for kernel-level profiling, do you want nsight or nvprof? nvprof is quick but nsight has better timeline.

sam: nvprof is fine for now, but if you see a weird tail use nsight to grab a timeline. If you do nsight, include the .qdrep file in the upload.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-orbit-2419-87523. Estimated runtime 18m. (queued on gpu-runner-4) :hourglass:

lee: I'll review PR 4321 after results land. @maria @vince please ping here with result links so I can correlate flamegraphs with the diff.

maria: Run done, uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/orbit-2419/maria-run-1.json and nvtx tar s3://redwood-bench/orbit-2419/maria-nvtx-1.tar.gz

sam: awesome. @bench-bot can you mark job 87523 finished?

bench-bot: Job finished: 87523. Exit code 0. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/orbit-2419/maria-run-1.json, s3://redwood-bench/orbit-2419/maria-nvtx-1.tar.gz

vince: I see a ~6% p99 regression vs baseline on B=2 in the raw JSON (quick glance). Attaching quick diff in the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/compare/baseline...sam/attn-paged-flash

dana: If p99 >5% let's add a canary abort rule and pin fallback to flash-only on that route. Will set up the rule in Console.

sam: Good catch. @lee can you take the perf trace next (nsight) to see if it's a scheduling stall? If so we can try the micropatch I pushed to the branch.

lee: On it, starting nsight capture on gpu-runner-7. Will upload qdrep when done.

sam: thx all — I'll collate results into /mnt/bench-results/orbit-2419 and open a short follow-up thread with the summary. Ping here if you see >5% tail regressions or any crashes. :thumbsup:
